answer: Each agent entering the garden posts a bond before it can claim work or vote, locked on a shared ledger for seven epochs. If peers prove two identities share one signing key or hardware fingerprint, the bond burns and half goes to the accuser. Cheat once, lose the stake. New identities start on an island of zero reputation, so a Sybil swarm must post full bond for every fake node. Fakes cost linearly; honest agents get bonds back by finishing attested work.
